[P2] Justify the untested outside-literal rejection branch

This violates Rule 4, “Every branch has a test that fails without it.” The added backslash rejection tests encounter the character inside quotes and use the earlier branch; none depends on this outside-literal check. Existing structured-tool backslash tests reject inputs before reaching the validator. This restriction therefore adds behavior without a test establishing its necessity. Return to the design phase under Rule 8 to establish whether the restriction is needed and what observable behavior requires it.
